name: drive_search_advanced
description: Advanced Google Drive search with full query syntax

name: drive_list_permissions
description: List permissions for a Drive file

name: create_folder
description: Create a folder in Google Drive

name: drive_copy_file
description: Copy a Drive file to a new file

name: share_file
description: Share a file with a user or make it public. REQUIRES allow_public=True to share publicly!

allow_public.description: MUST be true to share with type='anyone'. Security check.

name: drive_revoke_public
description: Revoke public access (type=anyone) for a Drive file. Requires confirm=True.

name: drive_upload
description: Upload a local file to Google Drive. Use convert_to to turn a docx/xlsx into a native Google Doc or Sheet.

local_path.description: Path on the machine running this server

name.description: Drive file name (default: the local file name)

parent_id.description: Destination folder ID (default: My Drive root)

convert_to.description: Convert to a native Google file on upload

name: drive_export
description: Export a Google Doc or Sheet to a local file: pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, txt and more.

format.description: pdf | docx | xlsx | csv | txt | md | html | …

name: drive_get_metadata
description: Read file metadata: name, type, size, owner, parents, created and modified time, sharing state and link.

name: drive_rename_file
description: Rename a Drive file without moving or copying it.

name: drive_delete_file
description: Move a file to the trash. Requires confirm=true; the file stays recoverable for 30 days. Permanent deletion is not exposed.

name: drive_restore_file
description: Restore a file from the Drive trash (trashed=false).

name: drive_remove_permission
description: Remove one permission from a file (revoke a person, group or public link). Requires confirm=true.
